condition.method: Reviewed the exact token, the finalized custody observation, the retained token metadata and IPFS path, the retained GIF and its recomputed IPFS CID, the GIF block structure and frame timing, the contract's runtime state, supply, and burns, the provenance receipts from mint to the Museum Safe, and the Museum flash analysis over all eight loop steps and close-looking census of the decoded frames (display evidence and its addendum 01).
condition.narrative: The token, its finalized custody, and the GIF bound by the on-chain IPFS hash are verified. The metadata's image URL points to a mutable CDN copy, the token URI base can still be replaced by the contract's authorized senders, and the animation flashes beyond WCAG 2.3.2 at every size and beyond 2.3.1 when shown large.
condition.protocol_state: ERC-721 static-file token on a non-proxy Nifty Gateway builder contract; IPFS metadata; animated GIF image

payload.state_history_semantics: Lifecycle observed_at values record source event times: offered is the Wave proposal's creation, authorized is the Wave decision time, acquired is the executing agent's Seaport purchase, received_onchain is the transfer into the Museum Safe, and accessioned is the Museum's acceptance and accession act. The Museum observed the earlier states on 2026-10-18 from retained evidence; acquired records the agent's purchase for the Museum, and title passes by the accession certificate's purchase title declaration.
payload.title: MAX PAIN #4188/7394

title_binding.basis: Acquisition Authorization 6529NM.2026.005.AQA-01 and the institutional purchase title declaration in Accession Certificate 6529NM-ACC-2026-005 bind the executing agent's transferable token interest to this exact object.

uncertainties: The metadata image URL is a mutable Nifty Gateway CDN location whose Last-Modified date is 14 May 2026; the IPFS image_hash binds the bytes.
The contract has not finalized the MAX PAIN type, so further minting is not excluded by code.
Whether the artist site's count of 4849 excludes the two 2026 burns is inferred, not stated by the site.

The animation's flash limits rest on the Museum's computation under the WCAG 2.2 definitions over all eight loop steps, which the accession's independent review covers; it is not a certified photosensitive-epilepsy test.
